bindingVerification.method: Read-only SHA256 verification of the manifest, browser result, all eight tiles, three source text screenshots, two empty-exercise screenshots, and both source HTML files. Each tile source path/hash matches the corresponding result screenshot or scroll-end screenshot. PNG IHDR dimensions match manifest crop dimensions; crop intervals are contiguous and cover the entire source height without scaling. No source screenshot was visually opened or decoded.

tiles.observation: Actual original-resolution pixels show literal $p$ and $n$ delimiters in the heading, rather than rendered inline math. The heading otherwise fits. Introductory paragraphs and body n, p, and p-n formulas are readable. Fig-224 has complete borders and centered n/p labels; fig-225 shows all n/p/A/V/-/+ labels clearly, with no label overlap. Both captions remain below their figures, and the following section divider and forward-current paragraphs are intact. The bottom crop boundary continues into desktop tile 2; it is not page-content loss.

Actual pixels show the continuation of the forward-current text, the reverse-current section, minority-carrier paragraphs, qualitative-graph caveats, and all three fig-226 panels a/b/c. I, V, 0, -V and panel labels are readable and separated from curves and arrowheads, with the caption below. The section dividers, two emphasized conclusion lines, final rectification paragraphs, body p/n/p-n formulas, and zero-exercise link are present and unclipped. No overlap, caption drift, or missing text was observed.

Actual pixels show literal $p$ and $n$ delimiters in the two-line mobile heading. The title and opening prose otherwise fit within the mobile margins; body formulas and line breaks remain readable. Fig-224 is fully visible with clear n/p labels. At fig-225's horizontal start, n, V, and the negative terminal label are readable; the p label/right-hand apparatus are outside or partly at the scroll-window edge and become readable in end tile 1. The caption and section divider stay centered and separate from prose.

Actual pixels show the forward-current continuation, reverse-current section divider and complete prose through the minority-carrier and qualitative-graph caveats. Inline p/n/p-n formulas fit, including formulas that wrap with neighboring text; no glyph is clipped. Fig-226 begins at the bottom, with the upper portions of panels a/b and their I labels visible at the horizontal start; its lower portions continue into start tile 3. The tile boundary does not remove content, and no text overlap was observed.

Actual pixels show fig-226 panel a's origin, voltage label and panel label, plus panel b's negative-voltage/origin/panel labels at the horizontal start. The remaining right-hand graph labels and panel c are covered by the end tiles. The fig-226 caption, section divider, both emphasized p-n conclusion lines, complete final rectification paragraphs, and zero-exercise link are readable and unclipped. Caption position does not follow or drift with horizontal figure scrolling.

Actual pixels again show literal $p$ and $n$ delimiters in the heading. Opening text and the full inline fig-224 remain in the same positions after scrolling. At fig-225's horizontal end, p, A, V, and the positive terminal label are readable with adequate separation from the circuit lines. Left-side clipping is the intended scroll window, with that content visible in start tile 1. The caption, following divider, and prose do not shift with the figure.

Actual pixels show all middle paragraphs, body formulas, and the reverse-current divider without layout movement or missing content after figure scrolling. The upper portions of fig-226 panels b/c and their I labels are visible at the horizontal end, with separated curves and axes; the graph continues at the crop boundary into end tile 3. No text overlap or formula clipping was observed.

Actual pixels show panel b's 0/V/b labels and panel c's -V/0/V/c labels clearly, completing fig-226's start/end label coverage. Curves and labels do not overlap. The caption remains centered below the figure; the following divider, both emphasized p-n statements, complete concluding prose and zero-exercise link are unchanged, readable and unclipped. No unrecoverable label clipping or caption drift was observed.

findings.title: Heading exposes raw inline-math delimiters
findings.observation: The desktop and both mobile scroll-state heading tiles visibly display literal $p$ and $n$. Body math is rendered, but the title's math is not. This is a pixel-confirmed formula-presentation defect despite the existing browser result reporting formulaErrors: 0.
